title: 第343章 他的一生下第342章 他的一生上
content_zh:
第343章他的一生（下）
洛一偏过头看她。
月光落在她侧脸上，将她白金色的长发染成一片柔和的银辉，她的目光没有看他，依旧落在远处那片海面上。
但她的睫毛在微微颤动，指尖也轻轻蜷缩着，抓住了身旁的石板边缘。
洛一收回目光，望向远处那片被月光铺满的海面。
“会的。”他说。
他顿了顿，然后轻轻握住了她那只正在暗暗用力攥着石板边缘的手。
她就这样让他握着，直到月光偏移了一个角度，将他们两人的影子融在了一起。
毕业后，洛一接受了光明教会的邀请，正式加入了教会。
弗嘉丽是圣女，是教会中至高无上的存在。
但当他真正站到她身边，他才发现，那顶圣洁的冠冕之下，藏着的是一副无形的镣铐。
她名义上是圣女，可实际上，教会的决策与她无关。
她被当作一件圣洁的象征，被摆在台前接受信徒的膜拜，可在那些紧闭的门扉之后，那些真正掌握权力的大主教和枢机们，将她排除在每一个关键决策之外。
他开始行动。
他接下了教会里几乎所有的危险任务，清剿魔物、镇压异端、探查禁忌遗迹、处理那些连教会内部都不愿触碰的棘手事务。
他的晋升速度快得惊人，从底层执事到高级骑士，从高级骑士到圣殿骑士长，再到后来直接被破格提拔为圣女的专属骑士，洛一只用了不到五年的时间。
而那些在晋升过程中被他顺手揭开的隐秘，让他看到了更多他不愿看到的东西，又或者说，让他看清了他早就该看清的东西。
圣女存在的真正目的，从来都不是领导教会。
她是一个容器。
一个供光明女神降临现世时使用的载体。

教会高层对此心知肚明，却从未有人向弗嘉丽提及，他们需要的只是一个随时可以被替换的空壳，一个在必要时可以被牺牲的祭品。
而当仪式真正启动时，弗嘉丽的意识、记忆、人格，都会被那场降临彻底抹去。
她将不再是她自己，而是变成一道通往神性领域的门扉。
他从未向弗嘉丽提起过这件事。
但他在行动上变得更加急迫了，他开始更频繁地出入那些他本不该接触的场合，开始更深入地调查那些被他刻意忽略的线索，开始构建一个足够庞大也足够隐秘的计划。
他用了两年时间，从圣女的专属骑士，最终被册封为神使。
那是光明教会历史上，第一次也是唯一一次，由一位并非出自高阶圣职体系的年轻人担任这个职位。
一年后，葬日谷。
那一天的光线，和往日没有什么区别。可当洛一孤身踏入那片谷地时，他知道，这不会是一个普通的黄昏。
前方，是那尊庞大的金色虚影。祂的面容在光芒中不断变幻，古老、模糊，如同一整片天空压在人的心头。
而在祂周围，散落着教会的核心高层们。
那些曾将弗嘉丽视作容器的枢机主教，那些曾将她排除在决策之外的大主教，那些手握权柄却从不在意她是否会消失的掌权者。
第343章他的一生（下）
他们依然站着，有的人已经察觉到了异样，正在试图后退，但洛一已经走到了他们中间。
他没有多说什么。
content_en:
Chapter 343 His Life (Part 2)
Luo Yi turned his head to look at her.
The moonlight fell on the side of her face, dyeing her long platinum hair into a soft silver glow. Her eyes did not look at him, but still fell on the sea in the distance.
But her eyelashes were trembling slightly, and her fingertips were curled slightly, grabbing the edge of the stone slab beside her.
Luo Yi withdrew his gaze and looked at the sea covered in moonlight in the distance.
"I will," he said.
He paused, then gently held her hand that was secretly grasping the edge of the stone slab.
She let him hold her like this until the moonlight shifted at an angle, blending their shadows together.
After graduation, Luo Yi accepted the invitation of the Church of Light and officially joined the church.
Fergal is a saint, the supreme being in the church.
But when he really stood next to her, he discovered that there was a pair of invisible shackles hidden under that holy crown.
She is a saint in name, but in fact, the church's decision-making has nothing to do with her.
She was regarded as a holy symbol, put on the stage to be worshiped by believers, but behind those closed doors, the archbishops and cardinals who really held power excluded her from every key decision-making.
He took action.
He took on almost all dangerous tasks in the church, eradicating monsters, suppressing heretics, exploring taboo relics, and dealing with difficult matters that even the church was unwilling to touch.
His promotion speed was astonishingly fast. It took Luo Yiyi less than five years to go from a low-level deacon to a senior knight, from a senior knight to a Templar captain, and then directly to an exceptional knight who was directly promoted to the Saint's exclusive knight.
And the secrets that he uncovered during the promotion process allowed him to see more things that he didn't want to see, or in other words, it made him see things clearly that he should have seen clearly a long time ago.
The true purpose of the saint's existence has never been to lead the church.
She is a vessel.
A vehicle for the goddess of light to use when she comes to this world.
The church's top leaders knew this very well, but no one ever mentioned it to Fujiali. All they needed was an empty shell that could be replaced at any time, a sacrifice that could be sacrificed when necessary.
And when the ceremony actually starts, Fu Jiali's consciousness, memory, and personality will be completely wiped out by that arrival.
She will no longer be herself, but become a doorway to the divine realm.
He never mentioned this to Fergal.
But he became more urgent in his actions. He began to go to places he shouldn't have been in contact with more frequently, began to investigate more deeply the clues that he had deliberately ignored, and began to build a plan that was large enough and secretive enough.
It took him two years to go from being the Saint's exclusive knight to finally being canonized as a divine envoy.
That was the first and only time in the history of the Church of Light that a young man who did not come from the high-level priesthood system held this position.
A year later, Burial Sun Valley.
The light that day was no different from the past. But when Luo Yi stepped into the valley alone, he knew that this would not be an ordinary dusk.
In front is the huge golden shadow. His face is constantly changing in the light, ancient and blurry, like a whole sky weighing on people's hearts.
And around Him were scattered the core senior leaders of the church.
Those cardinals who had treated Fergal as a vessel, those archbishops who had excluded her from decision-making, those in power who held power but never cared whether she would disappear.
Chapter 343 His Life (Part 2)
They were still standing. Some of them had noticed something strange and were trying to retreat, but Luo Yi had already walked among them.
He didn't say much.
